name: BFIX3 Structural Reach Gap (RECONCILE_DROP + AQR Epsilon Recovery)
description: BFIX3 (B_00 stale-account re-injection) does not reach all account classes that need rescue. Additionally, A_03 UNREALIZED_DAILY injection path may need an epsilon guard (`abs(units) < 1e-6`) to handle edge-class accounts (e.g., z0822229381 AQR). This project is the architectural follow-on to ADVI_49FRECN.003 — that TO closes on its sidecar-detection scope (Fix A); recovery completeness deferred here. Two TOs: B2 (low-risk A_03 epsilon guard, 0.5-1 day) + B1 (BFIX4 architectural mechanism in B_00, week-arc, Andrew gate).
